# ADR Template

Use this file as the starting point for `ADR.md` in `F1`.

## Decision Title

State the architecture or product-structure decision clearly.

## Context

- What part of the Kawa Network MVP are you designing?
- What technical and stakeholder pressures shaped this choice?

## Options Considered

List the serious alternatives you considered.

## Chosen Option

State the option you selected.

## Why This Option

Explain:

- what it improves
- which stakeholder benefits most
- which non-functional concern it supports

## Trade-offs

Explain what becomes harder or riskier because of this choice.

## Deferred Work

State what you are deliberately not solving yet.
